title: Plant Manager
text:
**PURPOSE:**

* Supervise the production of donated and new goods, assuring all personnel are properly trained in all areas of the production process.
* Maintain production standards and quotas for supplying all agency stores with saleable merchandise.
* Maintain inventory production records.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

Coordinates the following:

* Trains production associates to develop proficiency in providing proper classification of donated material and new goods.
* Evaluates the performance of workers and makes recommendations for changes if necessary.
* Monitor quality of processed clothing, wares, shoes, purses, books, etc. by spot checking racks and totes being distributed to stores. Monitor processed clothing for damage due to improper tagging.
* Monitor processed clothing and housewares for Consumer Product Safety Commission recalls.
* Monitor Falls Creek processing for safety issues.
* Maintain Kaizen implementation by conducting monthly Falls Creek Kaizen audits.
* Promptly report all instances of safety, and recall issues to responsible individual. Retrain individual on proper quality standards, safety policies, and CPSC guidelines.
* Sort’s incoming material into predetermined category, sends sorted materials to storage or proper activity or processing.
* Follows style trends to determine classifications of articles.
* Prepares and maintains records as directed.
* Takes note of any unusual or valuable items received.
* Assists in establishing performance standards for associates.
* Develops and trains to meet standards.
* Assures that all machines and equipment are used properly.
* Responsible for all safety and accident functions.
* Assures housekeeping and grounds keeping is attended.
* Orders supplies directly related to production.
* Keeps President and CEO informed on supply of unprocessed material.
* Assists in all production and transportation aspects.
* Must be able to stand for long periods of time, use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; push or pull.
* Must be able to occasionally sit, kneel, and climb.
* Must be able to regularly stoop, bend, squat, reach tum and twist body and lift up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

**RELATIONS:**

* Works under the general supervision of the President and CEO with authority to make minor decisions within established policies and procedures.
* Refers major decisions to the President and CEO.
* Works closely with Director of Mission Services and Program Specialist to ensure full integration of referrals into the workforce.
* Works closely with Warehouse Manager to ensure efficient flow of product to retail stores and required inventory of product is readily available for processing.

**STANDARDS FOR MEASURING PERFORMANCE:**

* The ability to meet or exceed cost and performance standards.
* The manner in which all material is processed.
* Effectiveness and detecting and safeguarding valuable or unusual items.
* Adequacy and accuracy of records.
* Degree to which respect and confidence of co-workers is established.
* Quality, quantity, and timeliness in the performance of assigned tasks.
* The manner in which one conduct reflects the high standards of morals and integrity expected of all Goodwill associates.
* Ability to meet deadlines and respond to special requests and the desires of management.

Benefits after 90 days include: agency paid life insurance and vision insurance, vacation, sick, holidays, and eligible to participate in group health and dental programs with biweekly co-pay. EOE

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school graduate or equivalent with prior management and supervisory experience.
* Must have good work habits and respond appropriately to supervision.
* Must possess adequate physical endurance to work at industrial standards.
* Must have a valid PA Driver's License and clean MVR, and clean Criminal History, Child Abuse, and Fingerprint Clearances.
